_comment: engine_Dev — BUILT-IN summoned-sidekick definitions (the reference game's 'golem' family). Lives here, not in engine source, so the engine carries no hardcoded setting strings. An uploaded 'summons' pack (dev console -> SUMMONED SIDEKICKS) replaces these wholesale, and the generic-default pack supplies generic sidekicks for a reskin; these are only the last-resort fallback. The summon/skill/weapon MECHANICS stay in golems.ts. Keyed by kind.

mud_golem.name: Mud Golem
mud_golem.blurb: Starter anchor. Cheap to bind, modest in every measure.

iron_golem.name: Iron Golem
iron_golem.blurb: Tank build. Tough frame, steady slashing strikes.

aether_golem.name: Aether Golem
aether_golem.blurb: Energy striker. Heavy aetheric blows pierce armor.

crystal_golem.name: Crystal Golem
crystal_golem.blurb: Apex anchor — the hardest to seat and the strongest in every measure.
